prompt:
Create one original, production-ready 2D game asset: a sleek angular crimson-red and white command boss spacecraft with a sharp commanding silhouette, a long spear-like nose, swept blade wings, and one central exposed cyan weak core set into an open mechanical cradle. The core must remain visible and unobstructed. Use broad clean armor shapes rather than noisy detail.

Camera: perfect orthographic top-down plan view, nose pointing exactly toward the top edge. Exact bilateral symmetry, no tilt, no perspective and no side view. Create a commanding large-boss silhouette that is clearly different from other bosses.

Reference 1 is only a rough guide to gameplay role and orientation. Do not copy its pixel-art rendering, original palette, silhouette details, or background. The written design brief has priority. Do not place the reference image itself in the scene.

Style: crisp detailed non-pixel vector game art, clean hard-edged geometric contours, restrained broad panel details, clear color blocking, and distinct engines. No tiny noisy greebles.

Composition: exactly one complete ship, centered and large but with clear empty margin on every side. Show the entire nose, wings, appendages and engines without cropping. Pure uniform solid white background (#FFFFFF), no cast shadow and no scenery.

Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, insignia, interface, border, stars, planets, landscape, people, pilots, debris, additional ships, additional weapons or separate objects.

references.purpose: Грубый ориентир боевой роли и ориентации; уникальный дизайн задаётся промтом

visualCheck: Approved: full top-down command ship and visible cyan core; palette, RGBA edges and transparent margins checked on light and dark backgrounds.
processing: Border-connected background removal, matte color recovery, alpha crop, padding, one premultiplied-alpha LANCZOS resize, no upscaling
